title: Structure of periodic Mo/Si multilayers for EUV lithography
summary: Public study of periodic Mo/Si multilayer structure for EUV optics, useful for understanding how multilayer structure and interfaces affect reflective performance.

title: The refined EUV mask model
summary: Public refined reflective-mask stack model derived from EUV and X-ray reflectivity measurements and used for rigorous high-NA EUV imaging simulations.

title: 3D mask effects in high NA EUV imaging
summary: Public conference work analyzing non-telecentricity, contrast fading and best-focus shifts from mask 3D effects in high-NA EUV imaging and exploring image-enhancement concepts.

title: Recent Status of the Stochastic Issues of Photoresist Materials in EUV Lithography
sourceName: Journal of Photopolymer Science and Technology / J-STAGE
summary: Open-access review of stochastic issues in EUV photoresist materials, useful for connecting photon/material randomness to defectivity without treating the article as a process recipe.

title: Benefits of mask 3D effects in high-NA and hyper-NA EUV lithography
summary: Public 2026 conference paper exploring when rigorously modeled mask 3D effects can improve imaging fidelity in high-NA and hyper-NA EUV under specific modeled conditions.
